purpose: Ledger Service keeps the financial truth of Meridian Pay by recording all money movements as journal entries with debit and credit sides.

components.name: ledger-core
components.evidence: ledger-core is the service itself. It accept the entries, check them, write them and answer the questions about balances.

components.name: ledger-db (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: ledger-db (PostgreSQL) is the database with entries and balances.

components.name: ledger-events (Kafka)
components.evidence: ledger-events (Kafka) is the stream where we publish one event for each posted entry, so the other teams can react without ask us.

flows.evidence: The wallet and payment services send the entries to ledger-core.
Ledger-core write the entries and the balances to ledger-db and publish the events to ledger-events.
Ledger-core write the records about its work, and the operations team can read them when they need to understand a problem.
